name: Poly Dash (Geometry Dash)
desc:
This game is still in development. Please suggest feedback instead of disliking the game! 👍
🎵 Click to jump and fly across obstacles to the music!

🎮 Controls:
- Press Q to quit a level
- Tab to pause
- Z/X (L1/R1 on console) To place/remove checkpoints (practice mode only)
- A/D to change playback speed (temporary)

🛠️ The editor is currently in beta. Expect gradual updates over time.
Editor functions best on PC with partial support for mobile.

🖥️ Supported Platforms: PC, Mobile, Console

Game mechanics taken from Geometry Dash by RobTop (Robert Topala).
All game assets are completely separate from Geometry Dash.
All in-game audio belong to their respective artists.
